---
title: "Matthew"
---

# Matthew

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Matthew presents Jesus as the promised Messiah and King who fulfills the Old Testament. The book teaches that God's kingdom has come through Christ and calls people to faithful discipleship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 1:23</div>

<div class="identifier">Behold, a virgin shall be with child</div>

### Why This Verse

Fulfillment of Isaiah 7:14

### Chapter Insight

This chapter establishes Jesus' genealogy and miraculous birth. The key verse emphasizes Jesus as the promised Messiah and Savior.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 2:11</div>

<div class="identifier">They presented unto Him gifts</div>

### Why This Verse

Visit of the Magi

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the visit of the wise men and God's protection of the child Jesus. The key verse highlights God's sovereign fulfillment of prophecy.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 3:2</div>

<div class="identifier">Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand</div>

### Why This Verse

John the Baptist's message

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces John the Baptist and Jesus' baptism. The key verse calls people to repentance in preparation for God's kingdom.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 4:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Man shall not live by bread alone</div>

### Why This Verse

Jesus' response to temptation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jesus' temptation and the beginning of His ministry. The key verse demonstrates victory through obedience to God's Word.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 5:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Let your light so shine before men</div>

### Why This Verse

Sermon on the Mount highlight

### Chapter Insight

This chapter begins the Sermon on the Mount. The key verse describes the character and values of God's kingdom citizens.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 6:33</div>

<div class="identifier">Seek ye first the kingdom of God</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted verses in Matthew

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches about prayer, giving, fasting, and trust. The key verse calls believers to seek first God's kingdom above earthly concerns.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 7:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Judge not, that ye be not judged</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the best-known verses in Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter concludes the Sermon on the Mount. The key verse emphasizes putting Jesus' teachings into practice.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 8:8</div>

<div class="identifier">Speak the word only</div>

### Why This Verse

Centurion's faith

### Chapter Insight

This chapter demonstrates Jesus' authority through miracles. The key verse highlights Christ's power over sickness, nature, and spiritual forces.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 9:37</div>

<div class="identifier">The harvest truly is plenteous</div>

### Why This Verse

Call for laborers

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records additional miracles and Jesus' call to discipleship. The key verse reveals Jesus' mission to call sinners and show mercy.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 10:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Wise as serpents and harmless as doves</div>

### Why This Verse

Discipleship instruction

### Chapter Insight

This chapter commissions the twelve apostles for ministry. The key verse emphasizes faithful witness despite opposition and persecution.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 11:28</div>

<div class="identifier">Come unto Me, all ye that labor</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Jesus' greatest invitations

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jesus' response to John the Baptist and His invitation to find rest in Him. The key verse emphasizes the spiritual rest available through Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 12:34</div>

<div class="identifier">Out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks</div>

### Why This Verse

Heart and speech

### Chapter Insight

This chapter highlights growing opposition to Jesus and His authority over the Sabbath. The key verse reveals that mercy and righteousness are central to God's purposes.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 13:44</div>

<div class="identifier">The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field</div>

### Why This Verse

Kingdom parable

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains the Parables of the Kingdom. The key verse explains that God's kingdom grows through the reception of His Word.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 14:29</div>

<div class="identifier">Peter walked on the water</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous faith narrative

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records John the Baptist's death, the feeding of the five thousand, and Jesus walking on water. The key verse demonstrates Christ's compassion and divine power.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 15:8</div>

<div class="identifier">This people draweth nigh unto Me with their mouth</div>

### Why This Verse

Quotation from Isaiah on true worship

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts human traditions with true obedience. The key verse teaches that the heart, not outward ritual, determines spiritual condition.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 16:18</div>

<div class="identifier">Upon this rock I will build My church</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundational church passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Peter's confession and Jesus' first prediction of His death. The key verse identifies Jesus as the Messiah, the Son of the living God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 17:20</div>

<div class="identifier">If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous teaching on faith

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the Transfiguration. The key verse reveals Jesus' divine glory and authority.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 18:20</div>

<div class="identifier">Where two or three are gathered in My name</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted verses in Matthew

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches humility, forgiveness, and relationships within God's kingdom. The key verse emphasizes childlike humility as essential for discipleship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 19:26</div>

<div class="identifier">With God all things are possible</div>

### Why This Verse

Widely quoted encouragement

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses marriage, wealth, and commitment to Christ. The key verse highlights the cost and reward of following Jesus.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 20:28</div>

<div class="identifier">The Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister</div>

### Why This Verse

Core statement of Christ's mission

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches about grace, servanthood, and Jesus' sacrificial mission. The key verse declares that the Son of Man came to serve and give His life as a ransom for many.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 21:13</div>

<div class="identifier">My house shall be called the house of prayer</div>

### Why This Verse

Jesus cleanses the temple

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jesus' triumphal entry into Jerusalem and cleansing of the Temple. The key verse presents Jesus as the promised King entering His city in fulfillment of prophecy.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 22:37</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou shalt love the Lord thy God</div>

### Why This Verse

The Greatest Commandment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains parables and confrontations with religious leaders. The key verse summarizes the greatest commandments as loving God and loving others.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 23:12</div>

<div class="identifier">He that shall humble himself shall be exalted</div>

### Why This Verse

Central kingdom principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter pronounces woes upon the scribes and Pharisees. The key verse condemns hypocrisy and calls for genuine righteousness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 24:35</div>

<div class="identifier">Heaven and earth shall pass away, but My words shall not pass away</div>

### Why This Verse

Enduring authority of Christ

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains the Olivet Discourse concerning future events. The key verse emphasizes readiness and faithfulness while awaiting Christ's return.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 25

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 25:40</div>

<div class="identifier">As ye have done it unto one of the least of these</div>

### Why This Verse

Judgment and compassion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents parables of preparedness, stewardship, and final judgment. The key verse teaches faithful service in anticipation of the King's return.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 26

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 26:41</div>

<div class="identifier">Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation</div>

### Why This Verse

Gethsemane instruction

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the Last Supper, Gethsemane, and Jesus' arrest. The key verse reveals the establishment of the New Covenant through Christ's sacrifice.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 27

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 27:46</div>

<div class="identifier">My God, My God, why hast Thou forsaken Me?</div>

### Why This Verse

Christ's cry from the cross

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Jesus' trial, crucifixion, death, and burial. The key verse highlights Christ's sacrificial death for the sins of humanity.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 28

<div class="key-verse">Matthew 28:19</div>

<div class="identifier">Go ye therefore, and teach all nations</div>

### Why This Verse

The Great Commission

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the resurrection and the Great Commission. The key verse commissions believers to make disciples of all nations under Christ's authority.
:::
